'''Hans Ellegren ''' is Secretary General of [[Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences]],<ref>{{Cite web |title=Who is Hans Ellegren? |url=https://opoyi.com/science/who-is-hans-ellegren-766987/ |access-date=2024-01-08 |website=Opoyi |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=IMAGO. |url=https://www.imago-images.com/st/0170399253 |access-date=2024-01-08 |website=www.imago-images.com}}</ref> and Professor of [[Evolutionary biology]] and [[Genetics]] at [[Uppsala University]].<ref>{{Cite web |last=Ellegren |first=Hans |title=Ellegren Group - Department of Ecology and Genetics - Uppsala University, Sweden |url=https://www.ieg.uu.se/evolutionary-biology/ellegren/ |access-date=2024-01-08 |website=www.ieg.uu.se |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Lundmark |first=Johanna |title=Hans Ellegren - Uppsala University, Sweden |url=https://www.uceg.uu.se/aboutus/staff/hans-ellegren/ |access-date=2024-01-08 |website=www.uceg.uu.se |language=en}}</ref>

== Publications ==
Ellegren has published more than 300 research articles.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Hans Ellegren |url=https://scholar.google.com/citations?user=mMF6tLkAAAAJ&hl=en |access-date=2024-01-08 |website=scholar.google.com}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Hans Ellegren research |url=https://www.researchgate.net/scientific-contributions/Hans-Ellegren-39110827}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Hans Ellegren research 1 |url=https://www.researchgate.net/scientific-contributions/Hans-Ellegren-2119185159}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |title=Research articles |url=https://research.com/u/hans-ellegren}}</ref>

== Membership in Academies ==
Ellegren is a member of [[Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences]] (2010), the [[Norwegian Academy of Science and Letters]] (2015), and the [[European Molecular Biology Organization]] (2015). He is on the board of directors of the [[Royal Swedish Academy of Sciences]],<ref>{{Cite web |date=2022-01-17 |title=Hans Ellegren new member of the board - Sveriges Unga Akademi |url=https://www.sverigesungaakademi.se/en-GB/2021.html |access-date=2024-01-08 |website=www.sverigesungaakademi.se |language=en}}</ref> and a board member of the [[Nobel Prize]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Board of directors |url=https://www.nobelprize.org/about/board-of-directors/ |access-date=2024-01-08 |website=NobelPrize.org |language=en-US}}</ref>
